blocks.text: The in-game Halloween event has ended. Please note that Scav behavior toward Player Scavs and the penalty for killing them have been reverted to their standard settings.
Loading into and out of raids

We've made changes to every stage of connecting to a raid: the resource loading architecture has been completely reworked. Connecting to the server now takes place in parallel with loading the location, while unloading resources after a raid now frees up RAM more efficiently.
Game server optimization
Optimized server resource consumption, significantly improving hit registration accuracy and reducing packet loss.
Performance improvements
Implemented a number of optimizations to improve frame rate smoothness both during raids and when interacting with the Hideout.
Door synchronization
Reworked the network logic for interacting with doors, significantly reducing cases where their states become desynchronized between the client and server.
Memory leaks
Fixed issues that caused uncontrolled RAM usage growth and performance drops during extended gaming sessions.

As part of Patch 1.3.5.0, graphics systems and visual effects have been brought together into a unified technology platform called RenderStack. This lays the groundwork for quickly integrating new technologies in the future while already delivering performance improvements:
Vegetation and long-distance rendering: Reworked grass rendering and the distant projection system for trees and bushes;
Lighting and shadows: Updated the distant and interior shadow systems, making transitions smoother. Volumetric lighting now puts significantly less load on the CPU and GPU;
Environmental decals: Optimized decal rendering speed while minimizing system load;
Optics: Improved image quality and detail in optics while reducing FPS drops when aiming down sights;
Upscaling technologies: Improved the stability and image quality of NVIDIA DLSS, as well as the performance of AMD FSR 2 and FSR 3;
Fullscreen effects: Optimized the processing of injury, desaturation, and sharpening effects;
Seasonal materials: Optimized seasonal transitions by preloading landscape materials, reducing RAM usage.

Reworked the raid reconnection system for cases involving network issues or lost connections to the server. With the new implementation, the game won't need to reload resources or the world state, allowing players to reconnect to a raid faster once their connection is restored.

Please note that these changes don't apply when the game client closes unexpectedly (crash, OS failure, PC restart, etc.). In these cases, reconnecting will take longer than it would for connection issues.
We've also improved interaction with the game backend, allowing players to reconnect to game servers if their connection is lost out of raid.

The technical improvements listed above are the result of months of manual work by our engineers on the game's code. The team conducted in-depth profiling and reworked key internal systems, resulting in improved game performance that many players will notice. This work was not directly dependent on the engine version upgrade, but the transition will also make further improvements possible.

We've upgraded the project to the latest version of Unity 6, giving us access to modern development tools that we'll need to implement new technologies such as DirectX 12, FSR 4.0, DLSS Frame Generation, and others in upcoming updates.

Added the EXFIL Brothers Program to the game. As part of the program, experienced players (Operators) can receive bonuses for playing together with friends who have just started their journey in Tarkov (Candidates).
Operators and Candidates receive a 5% XP bonus for playing raids together, as well as other rewards tied to the Candidate's progress or game edition.

Candidate rewards are designed to make it easier for new players to get into the game. Operator rewards are intended to help during the later stages of progression and allow Operators to stand out with unique customization.
The program can be completed and rewards can be earned in any Escape from Tarkov mode, but it has no connection to Escape from Tarkov: Arena.
Rules

To participate in the program, an Operator must share their unique referral link from the "My Candidates" table with a friend. This table is located on the "Management" tab of the "EXFIL Brothers" page on the offiial website: https://www.escapefromtarkov.com/
To start the program, a Candidate who is logged in on the website must follow their friend's link and confirm that they want to establish the connection.
A player can become an Operator if their account meet the following criteria:
It was registered more than 7 days ago;
It has a level 30 character in any Escape from Tarkov game mode;
It has at least 40 hours in-game.
A player can become a Candidate if their account meets at least one of the following criteria:
It was registered less than 7 days ago;
It has less than 40 hours in-game.
To view the details and all available rewards, visit the "EXFIL Brothers" page on the official Escape from Tarkov website.

sections.title: Changes to faction relations between bots in PvE

blocks.text: We've reworked bot interaction logic to make the world feel more dynamic and unpredictable:
Significantly increased the chance of USEC and BEAR PMC bots teaming up and remaining non-hostile to each other;
Added a small chance for PMC bots to remain neutral toward a PMC player until the player approaches or attacks them;
Reduced the chance of PMC bots being neutral toward Scav bots;
PMC bots will more often initiate combat with Scavs and Bosses;
PMC bots won't attack player Scavs first unless the player Scav approaches or attacks them.

sections.title: Changes to PMC bot behavior on locations

blocks.text: We've changed the behavior system and number of PMC bots on locations. These changes affect their movement and activity.
Points of interest and movement
PMC bots will now move more actively toward points of interest and task areas. They can be encountered in areas they didn't previously visit, and their movement is now less linear and more varied.
PMC bot numbers and distribution

There will now always be PMC bots present at the start of a raid on a location. Their numbers are more consistent, with less variation. PMC bot spawns are also distributed more evenly across locations.
Added PMC bot spawns to The Labyrinth, where they will participate in combat on the location.
Depending on the location, PMC bots of appropriate levels will appear in raids. For example, The Lab will have more high-level PMC bots.
PMC bot gear, difficulty, and weapons
A PMC bot's gear, weapons, and combat difficulty now depend on its level and faction.
Low-level bots pose less of a threat to players and use gear usually available to players at lower trader Loyalty Levels.
High-level bots are more dangerous, use better weapons, and are equipped with high-level gear.
Prestige is a mechanic for high-level players that unlocks a set of new unique rewards and allows them to start their exploration of Tarkov again while retaining part of their progression.
To Prestige, players must meet a number of different requirements, which become more demanding with each subsequent Prestige level. These requirements may include:
High character level;
Completion of certain in-game tasks;
Construction of certain Hideout zones;
Completion of the main storyline;
Having certain items and a certain amount of money in the stash;
Leveling character skills.

The first Prestige level in PvE Zone has reduced requirements compared to PvP. All players who haven't reset their progression since the release of Escape from Tarkov can now do so through Prestige. In this case, they will not only receive its rewards, but also unlock the release content, storyline, Icebreaker chapter, and all future events.
Each Prestige level resets the player's profile progression only in PvE Zone.
When Prestiging, players can retain some gear, a certain percentage of character skills, and weapon mastery, up to 50%.
Patch 1.2.0.0 features six PvE Prestige levels.
Many rewards earned through Prestige in PvE Zone will remain with the player permanently, but only for their PvE Zone character.
There are also rewards that can only be earned through Prestige in PvE Zone but will be available in all modes:
TarCoins;
Unique dogtags;
Unique Shooting Range Targets;
Unique Hideout Posters;
Unique melee weapons;
Unique Tarko figurines;
Unique Secure container Gamma.
Improved server-side player position synchronization to reduce the number of rubber-banding situations. Further network synchronization improvements are planned for upcoming updates;

Added the ability to switch trading modes with "Ctrl+LMB": while on the trading screen, players can use the hotkey on an item from a trader or in their stash to automatically switch between the purchase and sale screens. If an item has been placed on the sales table and the player switches to the purchase screen, the item will remain on the sales table until they fully exit the trading menu;
Added the ability to pin players in the friends list;
Added a visual indicator for the "Run-Through" extraction status. The extraction timer will now be displayed in white if the player will receive this status when the timer expires;
Improved the interaction with drum magazines: loading ammunition through the context menu, unloading ammunition from the drum, displaying loaded ammunition, and loading an ammo pack;
Added the ability to inspect your own PMC dogtag on the character screen;
Improved the profile customization. Players can now choose which ending to display on their profile. Endings can be displayed on any player profile, including PvP, PvE Zone, and PvP Seasons profiles.
Balancing changes
Adjusted the PMC and Scav extracts: added new exits;
Added new loot spots in locked dorms rooms, the USEC warehouse, and other areas of the location;
Locked containers are now guaranteed to contain loot;

Balancing changes

To give players more control over the risks they face while moving through the location and reduce their dependence on random factors, the following changes have been made:
Rogues have moved from the water treatment plant to the mountain chalets;
There are no longer any stationary weapons at the water treatment plant;
The open areas along the main road have been reworked to provide more cover and additional routes;
All landmines have been removed from the water treatment plant;
A transition point to Icebreaker has been added to the location. The hovercraft stays at the pier near the water cottages;
A temporary task chain focused on the shifting faction balance on Lighthouse has been added;
Loot distribution has been reworked. Rogue stashes containing their abandoned gear have been added throughout the location;
The BTR now patrols the location. Its route has several variants and covers the entire location, including the approach to the bridge leading to the peninsula and the water treatment plant;
Underground passages have been added in the mountains, shortening the route to the extracts in the southern part of the location;
The Marked Room has been moved from Lightkeeper's peninsula;
The location of the Prapor's camp required for main story tasks has been changed.

The task chain that unlocks access to Lightkeeper, as well as the requirements to start it, have been completely reworked. The chain is now more focused on testing the player's skills rather than repetitive tasks of the same type.
To receive the first task in the "To the Light" chain, you must:
Gain access to Lighthouse through the "Tour" storyline;
Have Loyalty Level 3 with all traders except Fence and Ref;
Ask Mechanic about the possibility of working with Lightkeeper.
Some tasks have been significantly reworked based on player feedback. For some of his tasks, Lightkeeper will now reward players with a rare key to a loot room located on the Lighthouse peninsula.
Several tasks that are primarily completed on Lighthouse have been changed. Several new tasks have also been added to make progression smoother.

With the release of Patch 1.1.0.0, the Seasons system has been introduced to Escape from Tarkov, along with the launch of the first season, KORD BREACH.
Each season will introduce new rules, mechanics, rewards, and gameplay changes designed to diversify the experience and provide players with new progression challenges.
Added a new Seasonal Character profile. Seasonal Characters exist on separate servers and are completely independent from PvP Zone and PvE Zone characters.
Seasonal Character progression is automatically reset every four to six months with the release of a major content update and the start of a new season.
Seasonal Characters can be created and switched between from a dedicated character selection screen.
Global Modifiers are season rules that alter, simplify, or increase the difficulty of specific gameplay elements.
Global modifiers:
Apply only to Seasonal Characters;
Are enabled for all players participating in the season;
Cannot be changed, disabled, or selected individually.
Each new season will feature a different set of Global modifiers, creating a fresh gameplay experience and new progression challenges.
In the future, we are also considering community voting that would allow players to influence the selection of Global modifiers for upcoming seasons.
A complete list of active Global modifiers is displayed during Seasonal Character creation.
Personal modifiers allow players to customize their progression by increasing the overall difficulty or making certain gameplay elements easier.
When creating a Seasonal Character, players can choose from both positive and negative Personal modifiers.
Each modifier has a point value:
Negative modifiers grant points;
Positive modifiers consume points.
The final point balance must be zero or higher in order to create a Seasonal Character.
Selecting Personal modifiers is entirely optional. Characters can also be created without any Personal modifiers.
Once the character has been created, selected modifiers can be viewed on the Character screen, under the Skills tab.
Seasonal rewards are unique trader offers that can be unlocked by playing a Seasonal Character.
To unlock a Seasonal reward, one or more of the following conditions must be met:
Reach a specific PMC level;
Complete a specified task;
Complete a task chain.
Once unlocked, Seasonal Rewards become permanently available across all game modes: PvP Zone, PvE Zone, PvP Season.
Added a new task line, KORD BREACH. Completing this chain allows players to:
Earn achievements.
Unlock new Operational Tasks.
Unlock trade offers for highly valuable items.
Unlock a trade offer for the new weapon.
Added new trade offers for highly valuable items to the Seasonal mode.
Any Seasonal Rewards that remain locked at the end of the KORD BREACH season will become permanently unobtainable. Rewards already unlocked will remain permanently available on the player's account.
A free Battle Pass has been added alongside the launch of the first KORD BREACH season.
Battle Pass progression is shared across all game modes: PvP Season, PvP Zone, and PvE Zone.
To progress through the Battle Pass and unlock rewards, players must find and submit TerraGroup documentation.
Rewards can be unlocked once the required number of documents is present in the inventory of any game mode. Once unlocked, rewards become available across all modes simultaneously.
Documents can be obtained:
During raids across various Tarkov locations;
By completing the KORD BREACH special task line;
By eliminating certain Black Division operatives.

Documentation found in raids functions similarly to task items. Each player receives their own personal document spawns. Documentation found on defeated Black Division operatives is also shared among all players. Other players cannot pick up documentation intended for you before you do or loot it from your PMC's body.
The amount of documentation that can be found in raids each day is limited. The daily limit depends on the selected game mode, while progress toward that limit is shared across all modes.
A new document type, Classified Documents, has also been introduced. It acts as a universal resource that can replace any other document when unlocking Battle Pass rewards.
Classified Documents can be purchased through the Expansion Hub.
Added new achievements, including seasonal achievements.
Seasonal achievement rules:
Seasonal achievements can only be earned by a Seasonal Character.
After a season ends, these achievements can still be earned in future seasons.
The Kappa Path achievement:
Starting with Season 1, this achievement can no longer be earned;
Instead, players who complete the Collector task will receive the Dawn of a New Era achievement;

Players who have already earned The Kappa Path will keep it in their in-game profile. However, it will no longer be displayed on Steam, allowing players to continue earning 100% achievement completion.
The Chris's Heir achievement has had its rarity changed from Common to Rare.

sections.title: Side task rebalance and distribution changes

blocks.text: The side task distribution system has been reworked. Most side tasks are now tied to a specific Trader Loyalty Level (LL). These tasks become available in small groups of 2-4 tasks for each trader. To unlock the next group, players must either complete several tasks at the current Trader LL or reach the next Trader LL.
The primary goal of these changes is to make progression less linear and less dependent on specific tasks.
The primary rewards for these tasks are now money, XP, and Trader reputation.
Some side tasks will continue to unlock as part of task chains regardless of Trader LL. These task chains will reward players with especially rare trader offers or crafting recipes.
Important rewards from these chains will now be displayed when accepting the first task, allowing players to see what they can unlock before completing the chain.
Additionally, a large-scale rebalance has been carried out for task rewards, objectives, locations, completion zones, and other related elements.
For side tasks requiring the elimination of Scavs, only regular Scavs, Sniper Scavs, and Player Scavs now count toward completion. Scav Bosses, Raiders, and Rogues no longer count.
Your squad can now help you complete certain task objectives. These objectives are marked with a special icon in the task UI.
How it works:
Eligible objectives may come from Story, Side, or even Operational Tasks.
Any player, regardless of level or faction, can contribute to your task progress, even if they do not currently have the task active. The only requirement is that they are in your group.
The assisting player must still fulfill all task conditions, such as distance, required equipment, active status effects, and so on.
Some tasks remain strictly solo. We consider completing these tasks alone to be an important test of player skill (for example, The Tarkov Shooter, The Punisher, and similar task chains).
The following changes apply to all game modes: PvP Season, PvP Zone, and PvE Zone.
Economy:
Increased the trader prices by an average of 25%;
Reduced the price traders pay for items sold by players by an average of 20%;
Increased the Flea Market fee from 3% to 5%.
Traders:
Removed the required trader sales volume from Loyalty Level requirements;
Rebalanced the reputation requirements for all Loyalty Levels of the following traders: Prapor, Therapist, Fence, Skier, Peacekeeper, Mechanic, Ragman, and Jaeger;
Reputation rewards from side tasks have also been adjusted;
Reputation values for existing PvP Zone and PvE Zone characters have been recalculated based on the new requirements.
Rebalanced the character level requirements for all Loyalty Levels of the listed traders.
Trade offers:
Several popular ammunition types and magazines previously sold at Trader Loyalty Levels 2 and 3 have been moved down by one Loyalty Level, making them available earlier.
Reduced the price of the following ammunition:
5.45x39mm FMJ
5.56x45mm FMJ
7.62x39mm FMJ
9x19mm Green Tracer
.45 ACP Lasermatch FMJ
Added new weapon presets to Trader Loyalty Level 1 for several traders;
Many trader offers previously locked behind task completion are now available immediately upon reaching the required Trader Loyalty Level;
Some trader offers previously unlocked through tasks have been moved to different task rewards;
Players who had previously unlocked these offers will lose access to them until they complete the new required task;
Removed the outdated trade offers that could still appear in Flea Market tooltips;
Ref's inventory now primarily features armor vests and plate carriers without armor plates installed, and their prices have been reduced accordingly;
Significantly reworked weapon mod trader offers, including which traders and Loyalty Levels unlock them, as well as their prices and purchase limits.
Hideout:
Simplified the construction requirements for some Level 1-3 Hideout zones;
In both PvP Zone and PvE Zone, the Found in Raid requirement has been removed from some construction materials;
Reduced construction times for certain Hideout zones;
The Workbench is no longer required to access the Weapon Build system. Weapon builds are now available from the start of the game;
Added money requirements to the construction of many Hideout areas;
Some crafting recipes previously unlocked through tasks have been moved to different task rewards;
Players who had previously unlocked these recipes will lose access to them until they complete the new required task.
Insurance:
Applies only to PvP Zone and PvE Zone, as insurance is disabled in PvP Season:
Added a new insurance option from Jaeger. It offers the fastest return time but is also the most expensive. However, Jaeger doesn't like to wait, so insurance return messages expire much sooner;
Insurance returns from Prapor and Therapist are now much faster, though their insurance services have become slightly more expensive. Insurance return messages are also stored for longer;
Higher Trader Loyalty Levels now provide a small discount on insurance.
Therapist post-raid healing:
Reduced the cost of healing;
Higher Loyalty Levels with Therapist now provide a small discount on healing services.
Weapon repair:
Weapon repairs are now slightly more expensive at lower Trader Loyalty Levels, but higher Loyalty Levels provide a small repair discount.
Experience:
Rebalanced XP modifiers for transitioning between locations;
Added XP rewards for completing story chapters.
Containers:
Increased the size of the Medicine Case and Magazine Case;
Adjusted their prices and barter trades accordingly.
Weapons:
Significantly reduced the accuracy penalty for revolvers and revolver shotguns when firing in Double Action mode.

Tactical clothing purchased from Ragman is now permanently unlocked on your account. You no longer need to repurchase it after resetting your profile, reaching Prestige, or creating a Seasonal character;
Increased the price of Ragman's basic Tactical Clothing;
The Predator Upper and Adik Tracksuit, unlocked through achievements, no longer require purchase and are permanently unlocked on your account immediately.
After your PMC dies, you can now spectate any surviving squadmate until they die or the raid ends;
You can leave spectator mode at any time and proceed to the raid end screen;
Spectator mode now activates automatically after your PMC dies. This can be disabled in the game settings.
Support messages now more accurately identify players who have fallen into difficult situations;
Players who die in a raid while in severe financial and equipment hardship will now receive a support message containing a special container with enough gear for a fully equipped raid;
This support package can be received no more than once every 18 hours, and the message must also be claimed within 18 hours of being received.

sections.title: PvP Season synchronization with EFT: Arena

blocks.text: Added one-way progression synchronization from EFT: Arena to PvP Season.
The following progress is transferred from EFT: Arena to PvP Season:
PMC experience earned;
Skill and weapon mastery experience;
Trader reputation and unlocked trade offers;
Currency, GP Coins, Lega Medals, and gear crates after completing the Jack of All Trades task in EFT: Arena;
Unlocked Tactical Clothing.
The transfer limit for currency and items in PvP Season has been reduced compared to PvP Zone.
Tactical Clothing is synchronized between EFT: Arena and PvP Season in both directions. If Tactical Clothing is unlocked in one game, it automatically becomes available in the other.
Important! Only PMC experience and trader reputation earned in EFT: Arena after the start of the KORD BREACH season will be transferred to PvP Season.
Previously earned progress will not be transferred.
Item transfers and Seasonal character progression sync from PvP Season to EFT: Arena are not supported.

For example, if your EFT: Arena character had already reached Level 78 before the season began, that level will not be transferred to PvP Season. However, if you earn, for example, 10,000 PMC experience in EFT: Arena after the start of the season, that experience will also be awarded to your Seasonal character.
Added a dedicated game mode selection screen, displayed when launching the game client.
Added the ability to change your PMC's appearance and voice in the new Customization tab.
Selected customization settings are saved automatically.
The player profile now displays:
Selected Personal modifiers;
KORD BREACH Battle Pass progress.
Added new interactive mechanics across locations:
Padlocks on certain doors;
Padlocks on certain containers;
Openable elevator doors.
Added new interactive environmental effects:
Breakable bottles;
Exploding fire extinguishers;
Vehicles that emit smoke after being hit.
Exploding gas cylinders have also been added to additional locations. Their visual explosion effects have been reworked.
Added new loading screen banners explaining the Scav faction rules and Fence reputation.

Implemented a new method of calculating the playable area on Streets of Tarkov. This reduces unnecessary location data processing and frees up more system resources to render the environment actually visible to the player.
Performed additional optimization work on Customs.
Norinco QBZ-191 5.8x42 assault rifle;
Howa Type 20 5.56x45 assault rifle;
HK 416A5 5.56x45 assault rifle in RAL 8000 color;
New attachments for PKM/PKP, AKS074U, FN SCAR, AR-15, and more;
New 5.8x42mm caliber:
DBP191 general-purpose cartridge;
DBX95 tracer cartridge;
DVC12 armor-piercing cartridge;
DBX12 armor-piercing tracer cartridge;
4 new streamer items;
2 new Tactical Clothing sets:
USEC Corsair
BEAR Airborne Infantry
Fixed an incorrect third-person player animation when stopping after walking;
Fixed the missing weapon sway while aiming;
Fixed the missing reload animations for bots in certain cases;
Fixed multiple culling issues across locations;
Fixed several incorrect voice lines for the USEC Rob voice;
Fixed the incorrect trader reputation calculations after reaching Prestige;
Fixed the incorrect distant LOD of the Lantac Dragon 5.56x45 muzzle brake;
Fixed the ricochet settings for gear with armor points, including armor vests, plate carriers, helmets, additional armor components, and more;
Fixed a UI freeze that could occur while interacting with the BTR Driver dialogue in certain cases;
Fixed the issue with the skill leveling bonus from trophies in the Hall of Fame, and removed the requirement for the player to personally score the kill.
Fixed an error that could occur when loading into a raid in certain cases.

This update includes a number of technical components and changes required for the upcoming launch of the Expansion Hub. The Expansion Hub will not be available immediately after the update is installed, and TarCoins will not be converted to players' accounts at this time. We will announce the launch date of the Expansion Hub separately.
Added the ability to search for tasks by name on the side task and operational task screens. Search now works by task name, objective, location, and Trader.
Fixed an issue that caused weapons to overheat too quickly on Streets of Tarkov in certain cases;
Fixed an issue where weapons could remain suspended in midair after a player's death in certain cases;
Fixed the incorrect female voice audio in The Lab;
Fixed the incorrect audio for certain gunshots at medium range;
Fixed a number of incorrect UI elements on the Character and Weapon Builds screens;
Fixed an incorrect animation for the MSGL grenade launcher's cylinder in certain cases.

How did the Paradigm Shipping icebreaker end up trapped inside Tarkov’s blockade ring? What happened to its crew? Who is behind it all? You’ll uncover the answers by completing a new story chapter during an expedition focused on exploration and PvE gameplay. And if answers alone are not enough, the loot will make it worth your while.

Icebreaker is a separate location for 1-3 players, available in all game modes. There, you will face AI enemies either solo or as part of a group. You will not be matched with random players on Icebreaker.
Added a mechanic that assists players in locating in-raid items required for tasks. Players will now see an expanded directional indicator when approaching the spawn location of a required task item;
Added additional notifications when interacting with signal flare extractions;
Added an experimental graphics setting that shifts the load of certain light sources from the CPU to the GPU. The option is available for higher-end graphics cards;
Increased chance of death after injecting Obdolbos 1 to 33%;
Added several new streamer items.
Added new USEC Gen 4 and BEAR Slavianka customization sets, available for purchase on the official Escape from Tarkov website and on Steam.
Fixed a cause of memory leaks related to the audio system in certain cases;
Optimized the animation system to reduce CPU usage;
Fixed an issue where the limb selection interface for healing could disappear in certain situations;
Fixed visual artifacts when using x2 and x4 resampling while interacting with Traders and the Hideout in certain cases;
Fixed the cause of error 228 that could occur when removing an expiring water filter from the Water Collector zone in the Hideout;
Fixed several visual issues related to geometry and colliders across locations;
Fixed a cause of severe client performance drops when dragging ammo from the inventory over a full magazine in the search window;
Fixed an issue where kills with Saiga-12K 12ga automatic shotgun (Redline) did not count towards progression of the tasks “Silent Caliber” and “Punisher p.4”;
Fixed the incorrect compass behavior after exiting the BTR;
Number of minor fixes to various aspects of the game.
Starting today, Escape from Tarkov editions receive new bonuses in addition to what they previously provided.
Your active edition will increase the experience gain in raid:
Left Behind Edition - 7% XP bonus
Prepare for Escape Edition - 9% XP bonus
Edge of Darkness Limited Edition - 12% XP bonus
The Unheard Edition - 20% XP bonus, applied to all group members

Group bonus does not stack with other bonuses or with itself. For example, if players with Prepare for Escape and The Unheard Edition play together, each will receive 20% more XP. Same goes for a group of multiple The Unheard Edition players.
Apart from that, owners of The Unheard Edition now have an additional opportunity for customization - it now allows using clothing regardless of faction.
This feature applies to all tactical clothing, including items from BattlePass and Tactical Maps from EFT: Arena.
These additions will make upgrades more valuable without affecting gameplay during the raid in any way.
New bonuses are also available to players who already own the upgraded editions.
A special offer is available on the official website: a 25% discount for purchasing and upgrading to The Unheard Edition.
Please note that the permanent 50% discount for upgrading from the Edge of Darkness edition to The Unheard Edition cannot be combined with the current discount.
This offer is active until May 20, 7:59 AM BST / 2:59 AM EST.
Improvements aimed at optimizing off-raid screens;
Increased the FPS limit in menus and added an option to adjust it in the game settings ;
Several changes to the animation system and audio engine to improve PC resource usage;
Reworked the architecture of post-raid systems to further reduce the time required to exit a raid and return to the menu;

As part of optimization efforts, an updated player culling system has been implemented on Lighthouse, Shoreline, Woods, and Ground Zero. The system will be introduced to the remaining locations in future updates;
Implemented an iteration of environment object and geometry optimization for Streets of Tarkov to improve location performance;
Please note that the impact of these changes will depend on your PC configuration and in-game settings.

Introduced a task progression protection system in local PvE Zone raids in case of unexpected client shutdowns. If the game closes unexpectedly, task progress will now revert to the state at the start of the raid;

Updated the left-shoulder firing stance logic. Switching to the right shoulder will no longer happen instantly when colliding with obstacles. Instead, the weapon will continue moving for a short period without changing stance;
Updated the K/D display in character stats. It now only counts PMC kills;
New character customisation options, gear and weapons from Season 2 of EFT: Arena have been added to Ref’s assortment.
With this update, we introduce the second stage of weapon mod adjustments, focusing on barrels and handguards. Muzzle devices and stocks were further adjusted based on the first iteration.
Barrels follow the same principle as before. Longer barrels provide greater recoil reduction but impose higher ergonomics penalties. Changes were made to:
Standardize parameters and make them clearer.
Make the choice between short and long barrels more meaningful.
Handguards no longer reduce recoil. Their role is now to offset ergonomics penalties imposed by barrels.
Muzzle devices were further refined following the first iteration. Suppressors and their combos with compensators now reduce ergonomics more and affect recoil less.
These changes are intended to further increase the popularity of "loud" weapon builds. It's worth noting again that adjustments to muzzle flash are planned for future updates.
Buttstocks received minor adjustments, mainly addressing inaccuracies from the first iteration.
Base stats of many weapons have been updated to better align with the new balance. Recoil and ergonomics have been improved for the following:
All AK, AKM, and AK-100 series weapons;
Steyr AUG A1;
Steyr AUG A3;
HK G36;
FN SCAR-L;
FN SCAR-H;
SIG MCX-SPEAR;
SIG MCX .300;
CMMG Mk47 Mutant;
Rifle Dynamics RD-704;
Aklys Defense Velociraptor;
All machine guns;
All bolt-action and marksman rifles chambered in 7.62x51, 7.62x54R, .338, and .50 BMG.
Fixed an issue where dead players and bots could appear to move visually in certain cases;
Fixed an issue where damage would not register after a weapon malfunction if the player had previously used a stationary weapon;
Fixed the cause of error 228 during trader dialogues that could block task progression;
Fixes to culling, shadows, textures, and location geometry;
Fixed an issue where armor could not be picked up if it was dropped while interacting with the modification window;
Fixed the incorrect behavior of PMC bots toward player Scavs with Fence reputation 6 or higher in PvE Zone;
Fixed an issue preventing further progression in The Labyrinth after spawning in the room requiring a burner tool to exit;
Fixed the incorrect display of smoke grenades in the player’s hands if another player threw a smoke grenade at them;
Fixed the display of changes in the “Combat Skill Leveling Boost” field in the Hall of Fame Hideout zone when one dogtag was replaced with another of a similar level;
Fixed an issue where PostFX settings would not display when preview was enabled;
Fixed an issue where some players could get stuck in the secret saferoom on Interchange without a way to exit;
Fixed the incorrect display of stationary weapons used by bots and multiple cases where bots could float while using them;
Fixed multiple issues with incorrect behavior of loot and gear items when dropped in raid;
Fixed the display of current movement noise level and stance height during raids;
Fixed the third-person animation for inspecting your own inventory.
Multiple improvements aimed at optimizing client performance across all locations. The impact of these changes will depend on the player’s hardware configuration and in-game settings;

As part of optimization efforts, an updated player culling system has been implemented on Customs, Interchange, and Reserve. This system has already been active on Streets of Tarkov. Implementation on all locations is planned in future updates;
Improved the responsiveness and smoothness of main menu tabs and dialogue loading;
Added the ability to play as a Scav solo in PvE Zone on a local client to reduce raid matchmaking time;
Added further improvements aimed at reducing online raid loading times;
Adjusted the healing priority for multifunctional medkits: after treating bleedings, priority is now given to head and thorax;
Added magazine drop sounds during reload and when discarding magazines.

Players who have previously purchased the Edge of Darkness edition, as well as those who upgraded from Edge of Darkness to The Unheard Edition, now have access to unique customization sets for both factions.
Figurines and posters previously available as rewards during the Release Twitch Drops event now spawn on locations;
Increased the available time window for transitioning from Shoreline to Terminal;
Increased the experience gained for completing PMC operational tasks;
Significantly simplified the PMC operational task objectives;
Removed the objectives for co-op extraction in both PMC and Scav operational tasks;
Reduced the number of Priest kills required for completion in the story chapter “They Are Already Here” to 1;
Reduced the trader response wait timers by 40% in the following story chapters: Falling Skies, The Ticket, The Unheard, The Labyrinth, and Batya;
Added alternative objectives to the story chapter “Tour” to simplify location unlocks. Players can now either visit the location multiple times or survive on it one time to complete the objective;
Reduced the duration of most Hideout crafts required for story progression by 40%;
Standardized the protection zones of front and rear built-in armor for light armor vests and armored rigs;
Adjusted the prices for most armor vests and armored rigs. Prices of plate carriers without built-in armor have been significantly reduced;
Increased the Raider count in The Lab by 20%;
Increased the quantity and quality of loot in locked and marked rooms;
Increased the fuel tank spawn chance at gas stations on Customs, Lighthouse, and Shoreline;
